con.text: Mayael is named successor by the dying previous Anima and undergoes the Whitecover Gaze, blinding herself for magical sight, and during the ritual she experiences the past lives of all previous Anima back to Cylia.

She journeys to the Valley of the Ancients and calls up Progenitus's spirit with the Relic, but a dark force disturbs the ritual, which Mayael mistakes for Progenitus, and it demands that the Cylian elves prepare for war.
Guided by her visions, Naya's elves, Nacatl and behemoths march to war with Bant and Jund, and when the shards merge Mayael finds herself general of Naya's mightiest army.

arb.text: Near death, the previous Anima names Mayael as her successor in the Sacellum, and Mayael undergoes the Whitecover Gaze and receives the memories of all the Anima.

When the Conflux merges the shards and Bant castles and Jund tar pits intrude on Naya, Mayael is powerless to stop it, so she rallies her army of elves and gargantuans to hold borders that no longer exist.
Black and blue mana stir the withered heads of Progenitus, who bursts from his tomb, and Mayael perceives that the Anima's task is complete and regards him as the world made flesh.
